rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone cannot resist doing V or reacting in a certain way.

example.english: Seeing his funny face, I irresistibly burst out laughing.
example.traditional: 睇到佢個樣咁搞笑，我忍唔住笑咗出聲。
example.jyutping: tai2 dou3 keoi5 go3 joeng2 gam3 gaau2 siu3 ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 zo2 ceot1 seng1

rows.jyutping: sai3 bat1 ho2 dong2 gam3 V
rows.note: Use this for a force, trend, or movement that advances unstoppably rather than for a personal urge or temptation.

example.english: This wave of reform swept across the city irresistibly.
example.traditional: 呢股改革浪潮勢不可擋咁席捲全城。
example.jyutping: ne1 gu2 goi2 gaak3 long6 ciu4 sai3 bat1 ho2 dong2 gam3 zik6 gyun2 cyun4 sing4
